rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone merits a result, reward, or outcome.

example.english: You deserve this award for doing so well this time.
example.traditional: 你今次表現咁好，值得呢個獎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 biu2 jin6 gam3 hou2 zik6 dak1 ni1 go3 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the person is rightfully entitled to receive something.

example.english: This overtime pay is what you deserve, so don't be so polite.
example.traditional: 呢筆加班費係你應得嘅，唔使客氣。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 gaa1 baan1 fai3 hai6 nei5 jing1 dak1 ge3 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3

rows.note: Use this mainly when someone is worthy of a title, status, praise, or other distinction.

example.english: They won the championship three years in a row and deserve the title “strongest player.”
example.traditional: 佢連續三年攞冠軍，配得上「最強選手」呢個稱號。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 zuk6 saam1 nin4 lo2 gun3 gwan1 pui3 dak1 soeng5 zeoi3 koeng4 syun2 sau2 ni1 go3 cing1 hou6
